text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-BGH100014CRVSS4, Bighorn 14 Inch Contemporary Stainless Steel Shower Door Pull Set

The Curved Stainless Steel Shower Door Pull comes packaged as a set including 2 pulls and the hardware needed to mount them back-to-back on a glass shower door. Because it is made from high-quality stainless steel, it will be sure to withstand extreme bathroom conditions. This pull is 14 inches long and has an 8 inch center to center. Choose from either polished stainless steel or brushed (satin) stainless steel finishes.

Specifications for the First Impressions Contemporary Stainless Shower Door Pulls:

  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Total Length: 14"
  • Center to Center Mount: 8"
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Packaged with 2 door pulls and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

Note: These contemporary stainless steel shower door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
